## What's new in 0.3.0
- Quick capture: select text in any app, then right-click → Services → Save to Backpocket - The selected result now previews exactly what Return will type - Search matches inside fact values, not just their names - Suggestions are ranked by the focused field's label, so the right fact is usually already selected - The palette now anchors reliably in Chrome and other Chromium apps, and opens instantly and settled - More dependable caret anchoring, focus, and placement across apps - A nicer installer: the download now opens as a proper drag-to-Applications window
